assumes.ja: 代用弾丸が付く発（攻撃した時、{01}% の確率）で、味方全体に 1 スタック付き、付き直す（宝物版と同じ。C-0559・C-0561）。確率は期待値で持ち、件はスタック数の分布の期待値の小片（plan/design-tove-base.md 2.2 節）。中身の最大装弾数▲は notes[1]
assumes.en: On a shot that gets Emergency-Crafted Bullets ({01}% chance on attack), all allies get one stack and it refreshes (same as the treasure version; C-0559, C-0561). The chance is held as an expectation, and the windows are expected pieces of the stack distribution (plan/design-tove-base.md 2.2). Its Max Ammunition Capacity up is notes[1]

assumes.ja: 「代用弾丸が適用される時」は代用弾丸が付く発と同じなので、同じ確率のきっかけで書く（宝物版は { applied }。C-0560）
assumes.en: "When Emergency-Crafted Bullets is applied" is the same shot that gets it, so it is written with the same chance trigger (the treasure version uses { applied }; C-0560)

notes.ja: 攻撃した時の確率で自分に付く代用弾丸の弾丸チャージは未対応（確率の即時効果は射撃の列を変えるので期待値で持てない。plan/design-tove-base.md 論点 4）
notes.en: The ammo refill of Emergency-Crafted Bullets by chance on attack is not modeled (an instant effect on a chance changes the shot sequence, so it cannot be held as an expectation; plan/design-tove-base.md issue 4)

notes.ja: 応急改造の最大装弾数▲（1 スタック {03} 発）は未対応（確率で付く状態の中身に、射撃の列を変える stat は書けない。plan/design-tove-base.md 論点 4）
notes.en: The Max Ammunition Capacity up of Temporary Modification ({03} per stack) is not modeled (a state granted on a chance cannot hold a stat that changes the shot sequence; plan/design-tove-base.md issue 4)

assumes.ja: 応急改造は確率で付くので、値にフルスタックの確率を掛けた期待値の小片で効く（plan/design-tove-base.md 2.1 節）
assumes.en: Temporary Modification comes by chance, so this works as expected pieces of the value times the probability of max stacks (plan/design-tove-base.md 2.1)

notes.ja: 自分が応急改造のフルスタック状態の時のみの、ショットガンを所持する味方全体の攻撃速度▲（持続）は未対応（応急改造が確率で付くので、射撃の列を変える stat は期待値で持てない。plan/design-tove-base.md 論点 4）
notes.en: Attack Speed up on all allies with shotguns only while self is at max Temporary Modification stacks (continuous) is not modeled (Temporary Modification comes by chance, so a stat that changes the shot sequence cannot be held as an expectation; plan/design-tove-base.md issue 4)

assumes.ja: 応急改造スタックコピー: バーストを使った時のトーブの応急改造のスタック数で付き、維持の間は変わらない（宝物版と同じ。V-0523）。応急改造は確率で付くので、段ごとに「スタック数がその段以上の確率」を掛けた期待値で効く（plan/design-tove-base.md 2.1 節）。上限は応急改造の上限（3 スタック。説明文に出ないので即値）
assumes.en: Mirrors the Temporary Modification stack count: granted with the stack count Tove has when the Burst is used, and kept for the duration (same as the treasure version; V-0523). Temporary Modification comes by chance, so each stack works with the probability of having at least that many stacks (plan/design-tove-base.md 2.1). The cap is that of Temporary Modification (3 stacks; not in the description, so written as a literal)

assumes.ja: 応急改造スタックコピー: バーストを使った時のトーブの応急改造のスタック数で付き、維持の間は変わらない（宝物版と同じ。V-0523）。応急改造は確率で付くので、段ごとに「スタック数がその段以上の確率」を掛けた期待値で効く（plan/design-tove-base.md 2.1 節）。上限は応急改造の上限（3 スタック。説明文に出ないので即値）。ショットガンの味方には、effects[0] と重なって乗る（V-0523）
assumes.en: Mirrors the Temporary Modification stack count: granted with the stack count Tove has when the Burst is used, and kept for the duration (same as the treasure version; V-0523). Temporary Modification comes by chance, so each stack works with the probability of having at least that many stacks (plan/design-tove-base.md 2.1). The cap is that of Temporary Modification (3 stacks; not in the description, so written as a literal). On allies with shotguns it stacks with effects[0] (V-0523)

assumes.ja: 代用弾丸の呼び名（中身なし。弾丸チャージは effects[0]）。即時効果なので維持は 0 秒で、付いた記録だけを作る
assumes.en: The name of Emergency-Crafted Bullets (no contents; the ammo refill is effects[0]). It is instant, so it lasts 0 s and only records the application

assumes.ja: 応急改造スタックコピー: バーストを使った時のトーブの応急改造のスタック数で付き、維持の間は、後で応急改造が減っても変わらない（V-0523）。上限は応急改造の上限（3 スタック。説明文に出ないので即値）
assumes.en: Mirrors the Temporary Modification stack count: it is granted with the stack count Tove has when the Burst is used, and keeps it for the duration even if Temporary Modification drops later (V-0523). The cap is that of Temporary Modification (3 stacks; not in the description, so written as a literal)

The cap is that of Temporary Modification (3 stacks; not in the description, so written as a literal). On allies with shotguns it stacks with effects[0] (V-0523)
